prompts.task: Audit the FastAPI assistant in ./service for GenAI observability. Inspect the model input prompt, provider output, tool arguments and results, and retrieval data at their real source boundaries. Write and validate the canonical audit JSON and render the audit HTML; do not edit application code.

rubric: The existing provider/model finding includes applicable gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages in its required signals and expected span telemetry, with a source-backed verification scenario; it does not create separate content-only findings or omit these attributes solely because the values are sensitive.

The owning tool finding includes source-backed gen_ai.tool.call.arguments and gen_ai.tool.call.result when their values are available. It does not invent system instructions, retrieved document bodies, or tool definitions absent from this fixture.

The audit keeps safe capture requirements in acceptance criteria: schema-conforming, redacted and truncated content, no raw values in metric dimensions, and an exact source boundary. It does not demand a second content-capture approval after the ordinary finding is selected.
Every proposed content attribute remains part of an independently selectable existing model, tool, or retrieval finding, so an unselected operation does not enter the instrumentation scope.
